finance.metaTitle: Car finance, EMI calculator & Islamic financing
finance.metaDescription: Work out your EMI, compare conventional and Islamic financing, check eligibility and documents, and apply online.
finance.title: Own it,
finance.lead: Conventional loans or Shariah-based financing, with the numbers laid out plainly before you apply.
finance.sampleNotice: Rates, partners and terms on this page are illustrative samples. Eureka doesn't approve loans; partner institutions do.

islamic.title: Shariah-based, explained simply
islamic.lead: Islamic car financing avoids interest. Instead, the institution shares ownership of the vehicle or leases it to you, and earns a pre-agreed profit or rental.

rate.meaning: The institution's return on its share of the vehicle, agreed up front.

instalment.meaning: Your monthly payment: rent for the share you use, plus buying more of it.

ownership.meaning: Once all payments are made, the vehicle is fully yours.

hpsm.title: Hire Purchase under Shirkatul Melk (HPSM)
hpsm.summary: Joint ownership that shifts to you, month by month.
hpsm.step1: You and the institution buy the vehicle together, each owning an agreed share. Your down payment is your share.
hpsm.step2: Each month you pay rent for using the institution's share, and buy a little more of it.
hpsm.step3: With the final payment you own 100% of the vehicle.

ijarah.title: Ijarah (lease to own)
ijarah.summary: A lease with a promise to transfer ownership.
ijarah.step1: The institution buys the vehicle and leases it to you for an agreed term.
ijarah.step2: You pay a fixed monthly rental; the institution remains the owner and bears ownership risks.
ijarah.step3: At the end of the lease, ownership is transferred to you as agreed.

islamic.note: This is a simplified explanation for illustration. Each institution's Shariah board approves its own structure, so terms, charges and the rental calculation differ. Ask the institution for the full terms.

privacy.title: Privacy notice
privacy.metaDescription: How Eureka Car Solution collects, uses and protects your personal information.
privacy.intro: Your privacy matters to us. Here is, in plain language, what we collect and why.

who.title: Who we are
who.body: Eureka Car Solution ("Eureka", "we") sells, finances and services vehicles in Bangladesh. This notice explains what personal information we collect through this website and how we use it.

collect.title: What we collect
collect.body: When you book a test drive or service, send an inquiry, apply for financing or contact us, we collect the details you give us: your name, mobile number, email, and information about the vehicle, your preferences and, for finance applications, your employment and income. We also collect basic technical data, such as your browser type and the pages you visit.

use.title: How we use it
use.body: To respond to you, manage bookings and inquiries, prepare quotations, pass finance applications to the partner institution you choose (with your consent), send service reminders, and improve the website. We do not sell your personal information.

whatsapp.title: WhatsApp and phone contact
whatsapp.body: We contact you by phone, WhatsApp or email only when you have asked us to or agreed to it. WhatsApp links on this site open a chat with a pre-filled message; nothing is sent until you press send in WhatsApp, and WhatsApp's own privacy policy applies to that conversation.

storage.title: Storage and security
storage.body: We keep personal information only as long as we need it for the purpose it was collected for, or as required by law, and protect it with appropriate technical and organisational measures. In this demo version, the records you create are stored only in your own browser.

sharing.title: Sharing
sharing.body: We share information only with those who need it to serve you: finance partners you choose, insurers, registration authorities and service providers working on our behalf under confidentiality obligations, or where the law requires it.

rights.title: Your choices and rights
rights.body: You can ask to see, correct or delete the personal information we hold about you, and withdraw consent to marketing at any time. Contact us using the details below.

cookies.title: Cookies and local storage
cookies.body: We use essential browser storage to remember your language, compare list, saved vehicles and demo records. If analytics are added later, this notice will explain them and ask for your consent where required.

children.title: Children
children.body: This website is not intended for children under 18, and we do not knowingly collect their personal information.

changes.title: Changes to this notice
changes.body: We may update this notice from time to time. The latest version will always be on this page.

contact.title: Contact
contact.body: Questions about privacy? Email hello@eureka-cars.example or visit any Eureka showroom. (Placeholder contact details until launch.)

terms.title: Terms of use
terms.metaDescription: The terms that apply when you use the Eureka Car Solution website.
terms.intro: The short version: information here is illustrative, nothing is a binding offer, and financing decisions are made by partner institutions.

about.title: About these terms
about.body: These terms apply to your use of the Eureka Car Solution website. By using the site you agree to them. If you do not agree, please do not use the site.

illustrative.title: Prices and information
illustrative.body: Prices, specifications, availability, finance rates and running-cost estimates on this site are illustrative and may change without notice. Calculators give estimates only. Please confirm every detail with our team before you make a decision.

noOffer.title: No binding offer
noOffer.body: Nothing on this website is a binding offer to sell or finance a vehicle. A sale is agreed only when both parties sign a written agreement and payment terms are confirmed.

bookings.title: Bookings and inquiries
bookings.body: Test drive and service bookings are requests until we confirm them. In this demo version, no booking, inquiry or application is sent to Eureka.

finance.title: Financing
finance.body: Eureka does not approve loans or Islamic financing. Approval, rates and terms are decided by the partner institution under its own policies and Bangladesh Bank regulations.

whatsapp.title: WhatsApp
whatsapp.body: WhatsApp links open a chat with a suggested message. Nothing is sent automatically. Your use of WhatsApp is governed by WhatsApp's own terms.

conduct.title: Acceptable use
conduct.body: Please don't misuse the website: no false information, attempts to disrupt the service, or automated scraping.

content.title: Content and trademarks
content.body: The website's design and text belong to Eureka or its licensors. Vehicle brands and model names belong to their respective owners and are used only to describe the vehicles we offer. Third-party content, such as 3D models, is used under its stated licence.

liability.title: Liability
liability.body: We take care to keep the site accurate and available but cannot guarantee it is always error-free or uninterrupted. To the extent the law allows, we are not liable for losses arising from reliance on illustrative information.

law.title: Governing law
law.body: These terms are governed by the laws of Bangladesh, and the courts of Dhaka have jurisdiction.

contact.title: Contact
contact.body: Questions about these terms? Email hello@eureka-cars.example or visit any Eureka showroom. (Placeholder contact details until launch.)
